recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change core FHIR source for FHIR-22104 unless Security WG opens a new issue to replace the current example ISO lifecycle sample with a different Provenance.activity vocabulary policy.
issue_request: FHIR-22104 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It asked for the Provenance.activity value set to include ISO 21089 vocabulary, using the AuditEvent type value set as the assembly model.
initial_application: The request was historically applied through the Security WG PR #708 path: commit b569c4406b1d2a7944cc4b25869f7075524fe4f3 added an iso-21089-lifecycle include to the then-current provenance-activity-type value set, and merge commit e5f777ad514d570245abf181a3637f154a2529a9 brought PR #708 into the specification.
additional_context: Later same-artifact decisions reshaped the value set. FHIR-23712 broadened provenance-activity-type, but later Published issue FHIR-32517 changed Provenance.activity to an example binding and narrowed the value set to representative ISO 21089 lifecycle examples. Later Applied issues FHIR-55798 and FHIR-55797 refined the description and added destroy while preserving that example ISO sample model.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current build-scope Provenance.activity element is bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type, and the current value set is an example set composed from representative ISO 21089 lifecycle codes.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue expanded the same value set, but it has already been audited on the combined branch and was superseded by FHIR-32517.
Later Published issue changed Provenance.activity to an example binding and narrowed the value set to representative ISO 21089 lifecycle examples.
